findings.title: Pre-flight GET /health can contact the deployed host when misconfigured; replace with zero-contact env assertion plus routes-manifest grep (design section 5 step 3)

PUT /events/:id is not a full replacement ($set of provided fields); empty strings for registrationEnds/category/theme/race start fail validation; specify serialization and non-clearable fields (section 1.4)
Open-redirect guard allows '/\evil.com'; require no backslash and same-origin URL check (section 4)
Next version described as locked but package.json uses ^16.0.0 (installed 16.4.1)
Dashboard 'participants' is sum of reserved seats, not participant count
Specify clearing BIB sends bibNo:null, never empty string
Add positive Origin check (allowed origin returns 200 through rewrite) to verification plan
